trans-unit.source: YouTube only plays embedded videos on pages that are served by a web server. This is a restriction imposed by YouTube, not by WebWriter.
trans-unit.target: Ní sheinneann YouTube físeáin leabaithe ach ar leathanaigh a sheachadtar ó fhreastalaí gréasáin. Is srian de chuid YouTube é seo, seachas srian de chuid WebWriter.

trans-unit.source: As a result, this video will not load in WebWriter's preview mode and in documents opened directly from a device. To let your students watch it, publish the document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and share the link from there.
trans-unit.target: Dá bharr sin, ní luchtófar an físeán seo i mód réamhamhairc WebWriter ná i gcáipéisí a osclaítear díreach ó ghléas. Le gur féidir leis na daltaí féachaint air, foilsigh an cháipéis ar fhreastalaí gréasáin (m.sh. WebWriter Cloud) agus roinn an nasc uaidh sin.

trans-unit.source: If you want to distribute this document as a file rather than through a web server, use a different video source instead of YouTube.
trans-unit.target: Más mian leat an cháipéis a dháileadh mar chomhad seachas trí fhreastalaí gréasáin, bain úsáid as foinse físe eile in áit YouTube.

trans-unit.source: Videos from other sources and uploaded video or audio files aren't affected by this.
trans-unit.target: Ní théann sé seo i bhfeidhm ar fhíseáin ó fhoinsí eile ná ar chomhaid físe nó fuaime uaslódáilte.

trans-unit.source: YouTube refuses to play this video here because the page doesn't identify itself to YouTube. This happens in WebWriter's preview mode or in documents opened directly from your device. Publish this document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and open it from there.
trans-unit.target: Diúltaíonn YouTube an físeán seo a sheinm anseo mar nach n-aithníonn an leathanach é féin do YouTube. Tarlaíonn sé seo i mód réamhamhairc WebWriter nó i gcáipéisí a osclaítear díreach ó ghléas. Foilsigh an cháipéis ar fhreastalaí gréasáin (m.sh. WebWriter Cloud) agus oscail as sin í.
